professionalSummary.text: Seasoned Platform Engineer with over two and a half years of hands‑on experience managing production message queue clusters, including broker upgrades and tiered storage migration.
professionalSummary.witness: Deployed cluster changes to the three production message queue clusters over two and a half years, including two broker version upgrades and the move to tiered storage, each under a change record in my name.

experienceHighlights.text: Deployed cluster changes to three production message queue clusters, each documented in a change record.
experienceHighlights.witness: Deployed cluster changes to the three production message queue clusters over two and a half years, including two broker version upgrades and the move to tiered storage, each under a change record in my name.

experienceHighlights.text: Handled production incidents on the platform on‑call rota, including a partition leader storm and multiple consumer lag events.
experienceHighlights.witness: On the platform on‑call rota throughout and handled the production incidents on my shifts, including the partition leader storm of July 2024 and four consumer lag incidents, all recorded in the platform incident log.

experienceHighlights.text: Monitored live throughput and lag dashboards post‑deployment and coordinated capacity changes with topic owners.
experienceHighlights.witness: Watched the live throughput and lag dashboards after each change and ran the capacity changes with the owning teams of the six busiest topics, recording in each change record which checks were mine and which were the topic owners'.

experienceHighlights.text: Executed staged cluster changes under documented load profiles before production deployment.
experienceHighlights.witness: Tested each cluster change on the staging clusters under the documented load profile before production deployment, with the staging results attached to the change record.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented cluster limitations and hand‑over conditions in change records and the platform runbook.
experienceHighlights.witness: Documented cluster limitations and the hand-over conditions for each change in the change record's closure section and in the platform runbook.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Change records for broker upgrades and tiered storage migration, including staging results and incident logs for July 2024 leader storm and consumer lag incidents.

skills.witness: Deployed cluster changes to the three production message queue clusters over two and a half years, including two broker version upgrades and the move to tiered storage, each under a change record in my name.

Ran the capacity changes with the owning teams of the six busiest topics, recording in each change record which checks were mine and which were the topic owners'.

skills.text: Documentation of cluster boundaries and hand‑over procedures
skills.witness: Documented cluster limitations and the hand-over conditions for each change in the change record's closure section and in the platform runbook.
